verdict.rationale: Fin Voice is a documented dedicated product ('Deploy Fin Voice', 'Fin Voice 2 runs on Apex Flash... latency-sensitive tasks', 'grounded in your knowledge base, and trained to apply your specific policies on every call'), indicating speech-in/speech-out phone support using the same knowledge base as chat. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of voice call quality or action-taking parity specifically for phone, and no detail on how actions (e.g., updating systems) work identically on voice vs chat.
